title: Insights into adsorbent-based pharmaceutical wastewater treatment and future developments toward sustainability
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,50597-50632
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06445G, Review Article
Open Access

Sadia Sharmin Sporsho, Dipu Saha, Mahmudul Hasan Khan, Md Shahriar Rahman, Mahe Rukh, Md Reazul Islam, Tulie Chakma, Faysal Haque, Hridoy Roy, Dipayan Sarkar, Md Shahinoor Islam
This article comprehensively reviews current state-of-the-art methods using next-generation adsorbents to remove pharmaceutical contaminants and discusses future remedial methods to achieve these treatments in a more eco-friendly and sustainable way.
